mapper.select: SELECT g.session_id::text AS "sessionId", g.session_name AS "groupName", m.byai_session_member_id::text AS "memberId", m.mem_obj_id::text AS "userId", m.user_role AS "role", m.mem_name AS "name", CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM m.create_time) * 1000 AS BIGINT)::text AS "joinedAt", (SELECT e.ext_param_value FROM byai.byai_session_ext e WHERE e.session_id=g.session_id AND e.ext_param_code='group_admin_since_' || m.byai_session_member_id LIMIT 1) AS "adminSince" FROM byai.byai_session g JOIN byai.byai_session_member m ON m.session_id=g.session_id WHERE g.enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND g.session_type='hs_as' AND COALESCE(g.state,'ACTIVE')='ACTIVE' AND m.com_acct_id=#{enterpriseId} AND m.mem_obj_type='USER' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM byai.byai_session_member target WHERE target.session_id=g.session_id AND target.com_acct_id=#{enterpriseId} AND target.mem_obj_type='USER' AND target.mem_obj_id=#{userId}) ORDER BY g.session_id,m.byai_session_member_id

SELECT u.user_id::text AS "userId", COALESCE(u.user_name,u.user_code) AS "name" FROM byai.tenant_user_membership m JOIN byai.po_users u ON u.user_id=m.user_id WHERE m.enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND u.state='A' AND COALESCE(u.is_locked,'N')!='Y' ORDER BY u.user_id

SELECT u.user_id::text AS "userId", COALESCE(u.user_name,u.user_code) AS "name" FROM byai.po_users u WHERE u.user_id=#{actorId} AND u.state='A' AND COALESCE(u.is_locked,'N')!='Y' AND (LOWER(u.user_code)='adminvip' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM byai.tenant_user_membership m WHERE m.enterprise_id=#{enterpriseId} AND m.user_id=u.user_id AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND m.role='OWNER'))
